Redis.__comment: Same instance as the other hosts — PaymentIntent's wallet reservation lock must be visible across hosts.

Cors.__comment: Vite dev server origins for the merchant portal UI. Adjust to your dev server port. Credentialed CORS requires exact origins, never '*'.

DevSeed.__comment: DEV ONLY. Seeds one merchant-portal login bound to the dev merchant (MerchantCode) so a fresh clone can sign in and see exactly that tenant's data. Never a real credential (§10).
DevSeed.__comment_additional: DEV ONLY. One login per demo tenant seeded by the MerchantGateway host's DevSampleData (set DevSampleData:Enabled=true there). Each binds to a different merchant, so portal work can sign in as each and verify tenant isolation actually holds — a single-tenant dev environment cannot surface a cross-tenant leak. A login whose merchant has not been seeded is skipped with a warning, never a boot failure.

Merchant.__comment: MUST match the other hosts' appsettings.Development.json exactly — same DB, so the dev merchant seeded here authenticates identically everywhere.

DevSeed.__comment: DEV ONLY. The fixed active test merchant the portal login binds to. Idempotent; matches the other hosts.
DevSeed.Name: Dev Test Merchant

KeyManagement.__comment: DEV ONLY. DevSecrets holds PUBLIC xpubs only — never a seed/mnemonic (§10). Matches the other hosts.
